objectives.description: Keep task_title and task_description separate; title primary, description supplementary
Cap description terms via DISCOVER_DESC_WORD_CAP + cap_words()
Match-strength threshold in tier1_search() (>=2 hits when >5 filtered terms)

approaches_tried.approach: cap_words() using bare awk NF/loop-index cap
approaches_tried.reason: awk resets NF/loop index per input line, so a multi-paragraph (multi-line) task description was capped per-line instead of globally, producing far more terms than DISCOVER_DESC_WORD_CAP (observed 90 terms instead of ~15-20 for task 70's own description). Fixed by flattening newlines to spaces via `tr '\n' ' '` before the awk cap.

deviations.description: Filter title and description independently through filter_terms()
deviations.reason: filter_terms() has no cross-token state, so a single call over the reordered/capped combined string is provably equivalent to two separate calls concatenated; chosen for lower structural risk.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — implemented as a single filter_terms() call ...)*

deviations.description: Add match-strength threshold in tier1_search() and the equivalent path in tier2_search()
deviations.reason: tier2_search() has no accept-on-first-hit call site of its own -- it delegates matching entirely to zotero-search.sh's own weighted multi-field jq scoring. Threshold added only where an actual call site exists (tier1_search()).
